resonance_difference.warning: Gives technomancers an edge over hackers; may instead be handled as echoes.

effects.Attack Protection: +2 dice on the Defense Test against normal Attack programs used on technomancers and sprites.
effects.Difficult to Analyze: +1 to the threshold of Matrix Perception Tests against technomancers, complex forms, sprites, echoes and widgets.
effects.Immunity to Crashing: Technomancer complex forms cannot be crashed unless the Crash action comes from a technomancer or sprite (who can still crash regular programs).
effects.Immunity to Defusing: A Data Bomb created by a complex form can be disarmed only by a Defuse complex form.
effects.Immunity to Nuke: The resources targeted by Nuke do not exist for technomancers and sprites.
effects.Invisible Node: The biological node is immune to standard wireless scans unless the scanner is a technomancer or sprite; may run active, passive or hidden toward them.
effects.Resonance Encryption: The Encrypt complex form creates code breakable only by a Decrypt complex form.
effects.Superior Trace: The Track complex form ignores Spoof-program confusion; only Redirect Trace with a Spoof complex form throws it.
